name: Standard Module Boilerplate
description: Boilerplate pattern for node.js modules under the Antigravity ecosystem.

boilerplate.exports: Module exports must explicitly define clear and minimal APIs.
boilerplate.error_handling: Always use try-catch blocks with helpful structured logs.
boilerplate.security: Validate all filesystem paths using a helper function before reading or writing.
boilerplate.imports: Keep static requires grouped at the top of the file, obeying layered architecture limits.
